changelog:
Initial release of the massive-data-feed skill for real-time and historical market data via Massive (formerly Polygon.io).

- Fetches stock, options, futures, index, forex, and crypto data for OpenClaw.
- Supports REST API (on-demand), WebSocket (real-time streaming), and Flat Files (bulk downloads).
- Requires Massive API key; S3 credentials optional for bulk Flat File access.
- Includes best practices for secure credential handling and describes plan-related data and connection limits.
- Provides reference documentation links for asset-specific data features.
summary: Fetch real-time and historical market data from Massive (formerly Polygon.io) for use in OpenClaw's trading decisions. Use this skill whenever OpenClaw needs...
